Our course was designed to give a wide range of information on Western historiography from the ancient times to the modern day. Throughout the semester, we had seen and discussed a wide array of approaches to history. This has been especially valuable for me to shape the approach I want to use in my thesis and broaden my horizons. Although I cannot think of a weakness for this course, it might have been useful if it included the historiographies and historical approaches adopted by intellectuals from other civilisations. That way, we might have been able to compare the Western understanding of history with those of other cultures, such as the Middle East and China etc.. I do strongly suggest everybody doing or planning to do a serious research on a historical topic to take a methodology course from him. I really hope he continues to give these classes. I certainly cannot wait to take another class from him.
